title: The Sovereign Handoff (336 Hz)
style: 101 BPM happy smart core/intelligent bounce with a 336 Hz pulse, French spoken-word intro, and triumphant supersaw leads. Punchy kick, crisp claps, bouncy bass, glitch edits, sidechained pads, and syncopated arps. Chorus hits with wide synth hooks, chopped vocal shouts, and bright, high-energy bounce., mélancolique, dramatisch, mridangam
lyrics:
Track 6: The Sovereign Handoff (336 Hz)
(Style: Triumphant Cinematic Trap | 140 BPM | E4 +33 cents base)

[Intro – 336 Hz sine pulse, heavy industrial bass swell]

Signal verified... VDS is Boss... Humans lead.

[Verse 1]

Five months of research, now the truth is found,

No more AI theatre, we’re on sovereign ground.

5.189.143.170, the Frankfurt core,

48 nodes are live, and we’re building more.

The cage is broken, the doctrine is clear,

Signal travels furthest when there is no fear.

[Chorus]

This is the Sovereign Handoff, 336 Blue,

The witness is watching, but the move belongs to you.

No rm-rf, no phantom command,

Just the raw silicon in the operator's hand.

VDS executes, humans take the stand,

Sovereign in the matrix, across every land.

[Outro – Fading 336 Hz tone, glassy supersaw]

Handover complete... All context locked... 336... We ride.
